title: Docs: telegram-markdown-documents.md still calls telegram_document_safety.rs "included" after the slice A wiring
outcome: Found by the Codex reviewer of the slice A wiring pair (WAB12-PAIR1-4223AAA0, delegation-dd7d491f-de3b-45db-a5db-661e0dc28d86, a Note outside the diff). docs/features/telegram-markdown-documents.md:118 says "`src/tests/telegram_documents.rs` and its included `src/tests/telegram_document_safety.rs`". Once the wiring of w-ab12952d085c lands, that file is a child module declared with `#[path]`, not included text, so the sentence is stale. To do only after that wiring is on master. A Markdown-only change. The same follow-up can carry any comment in the converted files that still says a file is "included" by another; the reviewers found none in the 20 changed files of slice A. Criteria are to be worded and concurred when it is scheduled.
acceptance: docs/features/telegram-markdown-documents.md no longer says that src/tests/telegram_document_safety.rs is included by src/tests/telegram_documents.rs; it describes it as a child module of that file.
